title: One-step CO2-to-methanol plant of Lacerda de Oliveira Campos et al. 2022 on chepta@0.6.2, stream by stream
question: Run every unit, then the sections, then the whole one-step plant with its recycles and purges as one flowsheet in the released chepta 0.6.2 through its command line; compare with the supplement's Tables S9-S10 and S14; record what CHEPTA refuses.
written_by: CHEPTA-Lab worker session (Claude); runs executed by this session on chepta@0.6.2

sources.note: Paper numbers from streams.json (Tables S9-S10) and equipment.json (Figure S1, Tables S13-S14), transcribed 2026-11-13; the article (sha256 8215079335f3...) and supplement (sha256 015d60b56ef5...) were downloaded again for this study into raw_papers/ (not redistributed). Kinetics: article Eqs. 8-11 and Table 1 (rights of Table 1: see README).

engines.note: Lab's package.json pin (chepta 0.6.2), installed with npm ci; called through its command line, chepta request --time-ms N <file>.

variants.description: Every unit alone, fed with the paper's Table S9-S10 streams.
Compression, synthesis loop (with its recycle and purge), purification (with column); streams entering from outside the section are the paper's.

modifications.description: Column with CHEPTA's partial condenser and a flash at 53 C; H2, CO and N2 traces bypass the column.

variants.description: The whole one-step plant as one CHEPTA flowsheet, with both recycles and both purges; the fired heater and steam cycle are left out.

modifications.description: Exchangers HE4, HE5, HE6 by their cold-side targets or approach; reactor coolant at constant 247.5 C; column by reflux and boil-up ratio.

variants.description: Runs that isolate a CHEPTA refusal (column start with trace gases, specification searches, column iteration limit).

warning_notes.note: CHEPTA reports k_ij sets used outside their data range in every run (H2 + CO up to 433 K above, H2 + N2, CO + N2, CO2 + N2, CO2 + methanol, CO2 + water, CO + methanol) and CO's ideal-gas heat capacity 21 K above its range in the reactors. Each run's list, with the blocks it applies to, is in comparison.json and COMPARISON.md. The warnings are kept, not removed.

assumptions.statement: Peng-Robinson with CHEPTA's k_ij is the method of every unit.
assumptions.basis: The paper uses NRTL2 outside the reactors (article p.9); CHEPTA has no NRTL pairs for the gases with methanol and water, and PR + MHV1 lacks methanol + N2 (runs u-flash3-mhv1, u-column-*-mhv1).

assumptions.statement: The paper's partial vapour-liquid condenser at 53 C is CHEPTA's partial condenser (all distillate as vapour, reflux ratio 2) followed by a flash at 53 C.
assumptions.basis: CHEPTA's column has one distillate, vapour or liquid; the product split of the flash is the paper's condenser equilibrium, the reflux composition is not.

assumptions.statement: H2, CO and N2 in the column feed (8 to 20 ppm each) bypass the column to the 53 C flash.
assumptions.basis: CHEPTA's column cannot start with them (runs diag-feed29-*, diag-column-*); the paper sends 98.6-99.9 % of each to stream 32 (supplement Table S2).

assumptions.statement: Fired heater, steam cycle and the water sides of HE3 and the reactors are left out; the reactor coolant is at a constant 247.5 C.
assumptions.basis: equipment.json: may be left out of the first case.

unresolved_inputs.item: Overall U of the reactor tubes.
unresolved_inputs.consequence: Assumed 300 W/m2/K; insensitive in runs at 150 and 1000.

unresolved_inputs.item: Isentropic efficiencies of the five compressors.
unresolved_inputs.consequence: Outlet temperatures 7-14 K above the paper's with 0.75.
unresolved_inputs.next_action: Could be back-calculated from Table S9 temperatures; not done.

unresolved_inputs.item: HE7: Table S14 24.2 MW against 19.75 MW from the printed enthalpies of streams 22 and 23.
unresolved_inputs.consequence: CHEPTA gives 25.1 MW for 22 -> 30 C (run u-he7): it supports Table S14.

unresolved_inputs.item: Table 1 of the article (Model-6p constants) is reprinted with permission from an ACS paper.
unresolved_inputs.consequence: The constants are in model.py and the request files.

limitations: Agreement with the paper is agreement between two simulators (Aspen Plus V10 with NRTL2 and PR; CHEPTA 0.6.2 with PR), not with measurements.
Fired heater and steam cycle not modelled.
No separate AI review session yet and no person's spot check of this study; draft only.
